These measures are being introduced (for the domestic Industry, including MSMEs) with the aim of processing applications for grant of licence within 30 days. These measures are being introduced (for the domestic Industry, including MSMEs) with the aim of processing applications for grant of licence within 30 days. The list of such products where applications are required to be mandatorily filed under option - 2 is enclosed.

These measures are being introduced (for the domestic Industry, including MSMEs) with the aim of processing applications for grant of licence within 30 days. The list of such products where applications are required to be mandatorily filed under option - 2 is enclosed.
